heading: Five actives. One compounded gel.
body: A compounded topical gel that combines finasteride, minoxidil, tretinoin, fluocinolone, and biotin in one topical base, applied to the scalp once daily to target hair loss locally with potentially lower systemic exposure than oral options.*
activeIngredientsLabel: Active Ingredients: Finasteride, Minoxidil, Fluocinolone, Tretinoin and Biotin in a compounded gel formulated for scalp adhesion.

ingredients.name: Finasteride
ingredients.body: Topical 5-alpha reductase inhibitor applied to the scalp, intended for localized scalp DHT reduction.*

ingredients.name: Minoxidil
ingredients.body: Vasodilator that may increase blood flow and nutrient delivery to hair follicles.*

ingredients.name: Tretinoin
ingredients.body: May enhance the penetration of other active ingredients through the scalp.*

ingredients.name: Fluocinolone
ingredients.body: A mild topical corticosteroid that may calm irritation, itching, and inflammation that can contribute to hair loss.*

ingredients.name: Biotin
ingredients.body: B-vitamin that may support keratin production.*

safety.title: Common side effects
safety.body: Itching, burning, redness, flaking, dryness, scaling, peeling, stinging, changes in hair color or texture, irritation at the application site, and increased sun sensitivity.

safety.title: Tell your healthcare provider
safety.body: Share any history of scalp conditions, sensitivities to topical medications, current prescriptions, and any history of low blood pressure or fainting.

safety.title: Do not use if
safety.body: You are a woman or a child. Finasteride is a medication for men only. Women who are or may become pregnant should never handle finasteride-containing medications.

safety.title: Seek medical care
safety.body: Severe scalp swelling, persistent rash, unexpected facial swelling, chest pain, fainting, or signs of an allergic reaction.
